Walkthrough

The pull request changes HIL board lock-name resolution and removes per-roster selectors. It applies RP2350 halt-first handling to OpenOCD resets and checks reset output for post-reset NMI halts. It also changes Reset_TT timeout handling to track surviving helper processes and retain hub holds while their status is uncertain. Process-group waiting now continues if its survivor-check worker fails to start. **Possibly related issues** - [hathach/agentrc#370](https://github.com/hathach/agentrc/issues/370): The change tracks timed-out Reset_TT helper processes and can clear a hub hold after scans confirm that no helper remains. The issue is partly addressed because it also mentions a hardware test and a separate battery behavior. **Possibly related PRs** - [hathach/agentrc#400](https://github.com/hathach/agentrc/pull/400): Both PRs change HIL board lock-name resolution and add RP2350 OpenOCD halt-first handling, for reset here and program in PR `#400`.
**Severity of issue fixed:** Medium
Merge Risk: Low · previous review 7eb86

The change halts RP2350 cores before OpenOCD resets, tracks timed-out hub helpers, and simplifies lock naming. The earlier concerns have been addressed. One test does not verify that a failed survivor scan preserves the TERM grace period, so a future regression there could go unnoticed. The risk to merging is low.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names three changes: halting RP2350 cores before reset, releasing finished Reset_TT holds, and retiring the project lock field. The raw summary and objectives confirm all three appear in the changeset (hil_flash.py halt-before-reset, hil_tt.py per-hub survivor tracking, hil_boards.lock_name signature change). It is specific and matches the main changes, though it is long and lists three items.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description states the linked issues (`#418`, `#420`, partly `#370`), the merge-order dependency on tinyuf2 and tinyusb, the problem and solution for each issue, what is not covered, and the testing results. It matches the changeset closely.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** Changes map to the linked issues or to the PR's stated scope. hil_flash.py, its tests, and the usb-kernel-recover RP2350 rung 1 text support `#418`. hil_boards.py, hil_reserve.py, arduino_build.py, the hil SKILL.md contract text, the roster test data, and the related tests support `#420`. hil_tt.py, hil_process.py, their tests, and the usb-kernel-recover rung 2 text support the `#370` hub-hold work that the PR description says it partly addresses. `#370` is not in the linked issue list, so this rests on the PR description. No change was found that is unrelated to the PR's stated purpose.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#420`] Met. hil_boards.lock_name(entry, *, path=REGISTRY) drops the project-owned lock argument. Registered boards use the registry name. Bench boards use the roster name. hil_reserve --roster FILE drops SELECTOR. arduino_build's roster check compares registry names. The tinyuf2.lock fixture is removed from tests/data/hil_reserve/tinyuf2.json. The tinyuf2 and tinyusb pin changes are external merge prerequisites stated in the PR description. [`#418`] Partly met. The agentrc path is covered. hil_flash.py now uses HALT_BEFORE_RESET_CFG, so both cores are halted before reset_openocd. reset_openocd polls each core and prints the 'hil_flash: reset' mark before 'reset run'. reset_problem refuses a Handler NMI halt only after that mark. The Hardware A/B data (8 of 221 baseline resets in NMI, 0 of 226 with halt-first) and unit tests support this change. Issue `#418` also requires the same halt before the Adafruit_TinyUSB_Arduino console --reset probe reset, with a command-line unit test, if the fault reproduces. The PR changes no code for that path, and the PR description does not state that the path is deferred. The fault did reproduce on console --reset in the baseline, so the requirement applies. Whether the console path reaches the agentrc reset_openocd code was not established by the available evidence. **Resolution** For `#418`: add the halt-before-reset to the Arduino console --reset probe reset path, with a command-line unit test. Alternatively, move that path to a separate tracked change. If the path moves, change 'Closes `#418`' to a partial reference and state the remaining scope in the PR description.
